# RAPID step 2 results (generated by rapid/step2.py)

9434 experiments, 45 amines (MCC averaged over all amines; AUC over amines with both outcomes in the scored rows). k shots drawn at random 20 times per amine and averaged; cells: mean over amines [95% amine-bootstrap interval, 1000 resamples]. Retrain weight for the k shots: 10.0. Recalibration prior strength: 1.0. Experiments flagged as model-chosen by the original team (_raw_model_predicted > 0): 20.5%.

## verdict
주 판정 (k = 8, 보정이 보정 없음과 새 아민 k번만보다 MCC가 높은가): **미달**

| k | 비교 | 지표 | 차이 | 2.5% | 97.5% | 판단 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | 보정 (주) − 보정 없음 | mcc | 0.012 | -0.008 | 0.034 | 우열 판단 증거 부족 |
| 8 | 보정 (주) − 새 아민 k번만 | mcc | -0.066 | -0.108 | -0.029 | 뒤가 높음 |
